verdict.rationale: VLP's VC practice page says it represents startups and also regularly counsels venture capital funds, corporate VC groups, pooled vehicles and angel/seed investors. It also handles seed, convertible, VC and PE financings, so it sits on both sides of the table. The 'knows current market terms' benefit is only implied by that dual representation and rests solely on the firm's own claims. Missing for 10: an explicit claim or data on current market-term benchmarks, and independent corroboration of investor-side deal volume.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: VLP regularly counsels venture capital funds, corporate venture capital groups, pooled investment vehicles and angel, seed and high net worth investors.
VLP's Emerging Growth Companies & Venture Capital practice represents venture-backed, angel-backed and self-funded emerging growth and start-up companies across a wide range of industries.
Angel investments and seed financings. Convertible debt and bridge loans. Venture capital financings.
